name: SliderField
description:
A slider with its label, track and current value on one row. The value's width is
reserved from the widest value the slider can show, so dragging never moves the track
(R9.1). The label column is a fixed width, so the tracks of stacked fields line up, and a long
label wraps; set `--slider-field-label-width` to change it. In a container narrower than 22rem the row wraps to the label and value above the
track. Hint, warning and error share Field's reserved message line.

Controlled with `value` and `onValueChange`, or uncontrolled with `defaultValue`. The
label names the slider and the readout is hidden from assistive technology, because the
thumb already announces its value text. Use `Slider` directly for a range.
signature: ({ label, value: valueProp, defaultValue, onValueChange, onValueCommitted, showValue, hint, warning, error, invalid, optional, required, message, dirty, touched, min, max, step, format, unit, locale, bubble, disabled, name, id, className, ...slider }: StandaloneSliderFieldProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: bubble
props.description: auto: the value bubble shows while dragging or keyboard-focused. always: pinned.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout only.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting value when uncontrolled. Default `min`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: error
props.description: Replaces the hint in place. Setting it marks the field and its control invalid.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the bubble and aria-valuetext. Default: the number plus `unit`.

props.name: hint
props.description: The message line's resting text. Only when the format or consequence is not obvious (R2.8).

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the slider. Shown at the start of the row.

props.name: largeStep
props.description: The larger keyboard increment.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for the default bubble and aria-valuetext number. Default: the nearest `LocaleProvider`, then `configureLocale()`, then `<html lang>`, then en-US.

props.name: marks
props.description: Tick marks under the track; `true` puts one on every step (use for ≤ 20 steps).

props.name: max
props.description: Upper value or visible-item limit, as specified by the type.

props.name: message
props.description:
reserve: the message line always exists (default for vertical fields), so an error
never moves anything (R9.1). auto: only rendered when there is a hint, error or counter.

props.name: min
props.description: Lower allowed value.

props.name: name
props.description: The component’s name or native form field name, as specified by its value type.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when a thumb loses focus, so a form can mark the field touched.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called continuously while the thumb is dragged or stepped.

props.name: onValueCommitted
props.description: Called once when the user lets go (or after a keyboard step).

props.name: optional
props.description: Marks the label "Optional". Prefer this over marking required fields.

props.name: required
props.description: Shows the required marker. Pass `required` to the control as well.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the current value at the end of the row. Default true. When false the bubble shows while dragging unless `bubble` says otherwise.

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: step
props.description: Increment used by keyboard and stepper interaction.

props.name: tone
props.description: The range colour. Status tones only when the value is a status threshold (R3.3).

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit after the number, joined with a thin space ("Mbps", "%").

props.name: value
props.description: The value, in the slider's units. Pair with `onValueChange` to control it.

props.name: warning
props.description: Non-blocking warning in the reserved message slot; errors take precedence.

props.name: dirty
props.description:
Whether the field's value has been changed from its initial value.
Useful when the field state is controlled by an external library.

props.name: invalid
props.description:
Whether the field is invalid.
Useful when the field state is controlled by an external library.

props.name: touched
props.description:
Whether the field has been touched.
Useful when the field state is controlled by an external library.
